name: Voltage Metals Corp.
summary: Voltage Metals Corp. is a Canadian mineral exploration firm primarily engaged in the acquisition and exploration of mineral properties across the country. The company concentrates its efforts on discovering deposits of nickel, copper, cobalt, and platinum group elements (PGEs). Its most notable asset is the St. Laurent project, a 4,170-hectare site situated in St. Laurent Township, Northern Ontario. Established in 2016, and formerly known as Mansa Exploration Inc., Voltage Metals Corp. is headquartered in Toronto, Canada.
